OBS Studio 32.2.2
https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio/tree/32.2.2

The OBS API declarations in crates/vsm-obs/src/bindings.rs were generated
from OBS Studio headers using rust-bindgen 0.72.1. This is a generated Rust
representation, not the original C headers. The original OBS portions
remain under GPL-2.0-or-later; they are not relicensed under VSM's MIT license.
